property.name: javax.jdo.option.ConnectionUserName
property.description: Must be APP — Derby's default schema. Hive 3.0.0's Derby schema script (hive-schema-3.0.0.derby.sql) has unqualified table references (TBLS, PARTITIONS) on lines 448/450 for the TAB_COL_STATS_FK and PART_COL_STATS_FK constraints. These resolve against the connecting user's default schema. All other 472 statements explicitly use "APP".table syntax, so the connecting user must also be APP for these two unqualified references to resolve correctly.

property.name: metastore.expression.proxy
property.description: Standalone Hive Metastore does not bundle hive-exec.jar, so the default PartitionExpressionForMetastore class (which lives in hive-exec) is unavailable. DefaultPartitionExpressionProxy is the lightweight built-in alternative shipped with the standalone metastore distribution.

property.name: metastore.task.threads.always
property.description: Default value includes multiple background tasks (DumpDirCleanerTask, etc.) whose classes live in hive-exec.jar, which is not bundled with the standalone metastore. Restrict to only EventCleanerTask, which IS available in the standalone metastore jar and is needed for basic event cleanup.
